article_content: Early Monday morning in Acapulco, Mexico, gunmen killed three police officers in attacks targeting two separate police stations, according to the state news agency Notimex. This violence follows a deadly street gunbattle two days prior on Saturday, which resulted in 18 deaths, including two soldiers. Mexican soldiers have been deployed to monitor the resort town, utilizing trucks and helicopters. The rise in violence, coupled with ongoing swine flu concerns, poses a significant threat to Acapulco's tourist economy and other popular resort destinations. Witnesses informed police that shortly before 6 a.m., armed assailants with AK-47 rifles emerged from two luxury vehicles and walked toward the police station in the Ciudad Renacimiento neighborhood, where they initiated gunfire. Notimex reported that officers Gilberto Reducindo Salazar and Arturo Tonala Aguilar were killed in this initial attack at the Ciudad Renacimiento police station. Subsequently, at a second local police station, attackers fatally wounded officer Andres Guzman Casiano, Notimex stated. A fourth officer sustained injuries in these attacks. The Guerrero attorney general's office indicated that the attacks, occurring within a 30-minute timeframe, might be linked and perpetrated by the same individuals, as reported by the state agency. It remains unclear if these attacks are connected to Saturday's shootout, which began when soldiers responded to an anonymous tip at Avenida Rancho Grande in Acapulco. Upon arrival, they were met with gunfire, according to a statement from Mexico's Ministry of Defense. Five individuals were arrested in connection with the Saturday incident. The Ministry of Defense reported that the Saturday gunbattle resulted in the deaths of sixteen gunmen and two soldiers, with nine soldiers wounded. Following the Saturday shootout, authorities seized a substantial cache of weapons, including 36 large-caliber weapons, 13 small-caliber weapons, two grenade launchers, 13 fragmentation grenades, 3,525 rounds of ammunition, 180 charges, and eight vehicles, as detailed by the ministry.

Šis smurtas seka po mirtinų susišaudymų gatvėje prieš dvi dienas, šeštadienį, per kuriuos žuvo 18 žmonių, įskaitant du karius. Meksikos kariai buvo dislokuoti kurortiniame mieste stebėti padėtį, naudojant sunkvežimius ir sraigtasparnius. Smurto augimas, kartu su besitęsiančiais kiaulių gripo nuogąstavimais, kelia didelę grėsmę Akapulko turizmo ekonomikai ir kitoms populiarioms kurortinėms vietovėms. Liudininkai policijai pranešė, kad netrukus prieš 6 val. ryto ginkluoti užpuolikai su AK-47 šautuvais išlipo iš dviejų prabangių automobilių ir nuėjo link policijos nuovados Siudad Renasimiento (Ciudad Renacimiento) rajone, kur pradėjo šaudyti. „Notimex“ pranešė, kad per šį pradinį išpuolį Siudad Renasimiento (Ciudad Renacimiento) policijos nuovadoje žuvo pareigūnai Gilberto Reducindo Salazar ir Arturo Tonala Aguilar. Vėliau, antroje vietinėje policijos nuovadoje, užpuolikai mirtinai sužeidė pareigūną Andresą Guzmaną Casiano, pranešė „Notimex“. Ketvirtas pareigūnas per šiuos išpuolius buvo sužeistas. Guerrero generalinė prokuratūra nurodė, kad išpuoliai, įvykę per 30 minučių laikotarpį, gali būti susiję ir įvykdyti tų pačių asmenų, pranešė valstybinė agentūra. Lieka neaišku, ar šie išpuoliai yra susiję su šeštadienio susišaudymu, kuris prasidėjo, kai kariai sureagavo į anoniminį pranešimą Avenida Rancho Grande Akapulke. Atvykę jie buvo pasitikti šūviais, teigiama Meksikos gynybos ministerijos pranešime. Penki asmenys buvo areštuoti ryšium su šeštadienio incidentu. Gynybos ministerija pranešė, kad per šeštadienio susišaudymą žuvo šešiolika ginkluotų vyrų ir du kariai, o devyni kariai buvo sužeisti. Po šeštadienio susišaudymo valdžios institucijos konfiskavo didelį ginklų arsenalą, įskaitant 36 didelio kalibro ginklus, 13 mažo kalibro ginklų, du granatsvaidžius, 13 skeveldrinių granatų, 3525 šovinius, 180 užtaisų ir aštuonias transporto priemones, kaip nurodė ministerija.

article_content: Newcastle fans ramped up their protest against manager Alan Pardew ahead of their Premier League 2-2 draw against Hull at St James’ Park on Saturday. Ahead of kick-off, angry Newcastle fans handed out thousands of posters with ‘Sack Pardew’ printed on. Disgruntled supporters also covered a van outside the ground in the ‘Sack Pardew’ poster as the much-maligned manager prepared for a hostile environment against Hull. Some of the home crowd continued to show their anger towards Alan Pardew with the 'Sack Pardew' posters. Under-fire manager Alan Pardew saluted the Newcastle crowd despite ongoing protests against his tenure. Angry Newcastle supporters are determined to see Alan Pardew sacked as manager of the club. The 'Sack Pardew' campaign hired a van with their poster on the side outside St James' Park before kick-off. However, despite a section of the crowd holding up 'Sack Pardew' posters in the stands, the majority of fans got behind the team during the dramatic 2-2 draw with Hull. In fact, the loudest noise to emanate from the home end was for the 17th and 18th minutes of applause for the two Newcastle fans who died in the MH17 disaster and for Jonas Gutierrez, who wears No. 18 for the Magpies, as the Argentine continues his battle with testicular cancer. Pardew said on Thursday he expected one of the ‘toughest days’ in the job against Hull, having witnessed calls for him to be sacked intensify after the humiliating 4-0 loss at Southampton last weekend. ‘This will be one of our toughest days, although I can think of some tough days I’ve had here. ‘The environment for the players on Saturday will probably be as tough as it’s ever been, and we have to accept that, knowing that Hull will come and try to make good use of our situation.’ This Newcastle fan has gone to great lengths to show his disdain for club owner Mike Ashley. Newcastle supporters have called for Alan Pardew to be sacked but are also attacking owner Mike Ashley. Newcastle fans enjoy a drink before kick-off against Hull as they raise 'Sack Pardew' posters to the camera. VIDEO: Pardew on the edge. ‘It’s going to be a difficult environment if we have the atmosphere we had at Southampton for long periods.’ Pardew held talks with owner Mike Ashley in the wake of last Saturday’s embarrassing 4-0 loss, a result which left the Magpies bottom of the Premier League. ‘We (myself and Ashley) had a long conversation on Sunday, and he was obviously disappointed with the performance. He has a right to be disappointed as the owner, and he relayed that to me.’ Newcastle owner Mike Ashley has relayed his feelings about United's terrible start to the season to Pardew.

article_content: LONDON, England (CNN) -- Burberry, the 150-year-old British luxury brand renowned for its distinctive check pattern, has recently experienced a resurgence. Christopher Bailey, Burberry's creative director, is widely credited with the brand's comeback. The brand attributes much of its revitalized image to creative director Christopher Bailey. The unassuming 37-year-old British designer has successfully reconnected Burberry with a trendy young audience by featuring figures like British supermodel Agyness Deyn—whom he helped propel to international stardom—in advertising campaigns. However, times are challenging for luxury brands due to a recession that has led many high-end consumers to seek more affordable options. So, how is Bailey navigating the current economic climate? With stylish new headquarters located in the heart of London and the recent launch of a Burberry Children's wear store in the capital, it appears the brand is maintaining momentum. Watch Burberry's creative director speak to CNN » Bailey believes the new headquarters are a crucial representation of Burberry's image, telling CNN, 'the building is the brand beacon.' 'It's vital that everyone embodies the aesthetic of Burberry. We have to pursue what feels right for the company,' Bailey added. Yet, this does not imply that Burberry is disregarding the recession. 'It's all about striking a balance between practicality and emotion. You need to be intuitive about current trends,' said Bailey. 'We are mindful of the global recession, but it motivates us to focus and ensure the brand's purity and integrity are reflected in all our actions.' 'We recently opened our first children's wear store in London, and initial indicators are very promising.' Nonetheless, Bailey acknowledges that 'there has been significant excess in the past five to 10 years, so it's an opportune moment to re-balance.' Consequently, how will this manifest on the catwalk? 'The clothes will be investment pieces designed for longevity. It's about more than just seasonal fashion.'
translated_content: LONDONAS, Anglija (CNN) -- 'Burberry', 150 metų senumo britų prabangos prekės ženklas, garsėjantis savo išskirtiniu languotu raštu, neseniai patyrė atgimimą. Christopheris Bailey, 'Burberry' kūrybos direktorius, yra plačiai pripažintas dėl šio prekės ženklo atgimimo. Prekės ženklas didžiąją dalį savo atgaivinto įvaizdžio priskiria kūrybos direktoriui Christopheriui Bailey. Nekrentantis į akis 37 metų britų dizaineris sėkmingai atnaujino 'Burberry' ryšį su madinga jaunąja auditorija, reklaminėse kampanijose pristatydamas tokius veidus kaip britų supermodelis Agyness Deyn, kurią jis padėjo iškelti į tarptautinę žvaigždžių padangę. Tačiau prabangos prekės ženklams laikai yra sunkūs dėl recesijos, dėl kurios daugelis aukštos klasės vartotojų ėmė ieškoti pigesnių alternatyvų. Taigi, kaip Bailey orientuojasi dabartinėje ekonominėje aplinkoje? Su stilinga nauja būstine, įsikūrusia Londono širdyje, ir neseniai sostinėje atidaryta 'Burberry' vaikiškų drabužių parduotuve, atrodo, kad prekės ženklas išlaiko pagreitį. Žiūrėkite, kaip 'Burberry' kūrybos direktorius kalba CNN » Bailey mano, kad naujoji būstinė yra labai svarbus 'Burberry' įvaizdžio atspindys, sakydamas CNN: 'pastatas yra prekės ženklo švyturys'. 'Labai svarbu, kad kiekvienas įkūnytų 'Burberry' estetiką. Turime daryti tai, kas atrodo teisinga įmonei', – pridūrė Bailey. Vis dėlto tai nereiškia, kad 'Burberry' ignoruoja recesiją. 'Viskas priklauso nuo pusiausvyros tarp praktiškumo ir emocijų. Turite būti intuityvūs dėl dabartinių tendencijų', – sakė Bailey. 'Mes prisimename pasaulinę recesiją, bet ji mus motyvuoja susitelkti ir užtikrinti, kad prekės ženklo grynumas ir vientisumas atsispindėtų visuose mūsų veiksmuose.' 'Neseniai atidarėme pirmąją vaikiškų drabužių parduotuvę Londone, o pradiniai rodikliai yra labai daug žadantys.' Nepaisant to, Bailey pripažįsta, kad 'per pastaruosius 5–10 metų buvo didelis perteklius, todėl dabar yra tinkamas momentas atkurti pusiausvyrą.' Vadinasi, kaip tai pasireikš ant podiumo? 'Drabužiai bus investiciniai gaminiai, sukurti ilgam. Tai daugiau nei tik sezoninė mada.'

article_content: The Dallas Mavericks took a giant leap towards this year's NBA title Thursday, as they defeated the Miami Heat in front of their own fans. Dirk Nowitzki was again the hero, scoring 29 points as the Mavs won 112-103 in Game 5 to take a 3-2 lead in the seven-game series. The giant German was one of five Dallas players to reach double figures for the evening. One more victory will see the Mavericks win their first ever NBA championship. 'We have to go down there (Miami) and basically approach Sunday's game as Game 7,' Nowitzki told reporters, in quotes carried by Agence France-Presse. Meanwhile, Miami forward Dwyane Wade was forced to play through the pain barrier with a hip injury, but still managed to finish as the top scorer for the Heat with 23 points. Teammate LeBron James also caught the attention at both ends of the court with 17 points, including a triple-double, and 10 rebounds, before his performance waned in the game. However, the visitors could not match their intensity as Nowitzki and Jason Terry in particular took the game to them. During one stretch in the final quarter, the Mavs went on a 17-4 run. 'We've been waiting for an offensive night for us where we finally shoot the ball well,' added Nowitzki. 'We felt like we had opportunities in the first four games, just couldn't make shots. So that was encouraging to see today that we made some shots.' Miami coach Erik Spoelstra said the team would be focusing on its inability to close out games. 'We haven't been able to do it consistently enough in this series,' he said, in quotes carried by Reuters.com. Their next opportunity will come on home court in Miami on Sunday.
translated_content: Dalaso 'Mavericks' ketvirtadienį žengė didžiulį žingsnį šių metų NBA čempionų titulo link, savų sirgalių akivaizdoje nugalėdami Majamio 'Heat'. Dirkas Nowitzki vėl buvo didvyris, pelnęs 29 taškus, o 'Mavs' 5-osiose rungtynėse laimėjo 112-103 ir septynių rungtynių serijoje išsiveržė į priekį 3-2. Vokietijos milžinas buvo vienas iš penkių Dalaso žaidėjų, pelniusių dviženklį taškų skaičių tą vakarą. Dar viena pergalė reikš, kad 'Mavericks' laimės savo pirmąjį NBA čempionatą. 'Turime nuvykti ten (į Majamį) ir iš esmės į sekmadienio rungtynes žiūrėti kaip į 7-ąsias rungtynes', – žurnalistams sakė Nowitzki, kurio žodžius citavo 'Agence France-Presse'. Tuo tarpu Majamio puolėjas Dwyane'as Wade'as buvo priverstas žaisti per skausmą dėl klubo traumos, tačiau vis tiek sugebėjo tapti rezultatyviausiu 'Heat' žaidėju, pelnęs 23 taškus. Komandos draugas LeBronas Jamesas taip pat patraukė dėmesį abiejose aikštės pusėse, pelnęs 17 taškų, įskaitant trigubą dublį, ir atkovojęs 10 kamuolių, prieš jo žaidimui rungtynėse nusilpstant. Tačiau svečiai negalėjo prilygti jų intensyvumui, nes ypač Nowitzki ir Jasonas Terry perėmė rungtynių kontrolę. Vienu metu paskutiniame kėlinyje 'Mavs' spurtavo 17-4. 'Laukėme tokio puolimo vakaro, kai pagaliau gerai mesime kamuolį', – pridūrė Nowitzki. 'Jautėmės, kad pirmosiose ketveriose rungtynėse turėjome galimybių, tiesiog negalėjome pataikyti metimų. Taigi buvo drąsinantis dalykas šiandien pamatyti, kad pataikėme keletą metimų.' Majamio treneris Erikas Spoelstra sakė, kad komanda susitelks į savo nesugebėjimą užbaigti rungtynių. 'Mums nepavyko to daryti pakankamai nuosekliai šioje serijoje', – sakė jis, kurio žodžius citavo 'Reuters.com'. Kita jų galimybė bus sekmadienį namų aikštėje Majamyje.

article_content: Frank Lampard is 'still playing like he is 18 years old' and driving Manchester City's Premier League title race with former club Chelsea, according to Pablo Zabaleta. Full-back Zabaleta hailed Lampard's growing influence as the City hierarchy consider whether to seek an extension to the 36-year-old's Etihad Stadium loan deal. article_content: Air travel today presents numerous challenges, including confined seating, baggage fees, and expensive airport concessions. However, air turbulence may be the most unsettling for passengers. Prepare for potentially more turbulent flights and increased fares. British scientists forecast that in-flight turbulence at high altitudes will intensify. A study published in Nature indicates that climate change will substantially increase turbulence over the North Atlantic, a heavily traveled route between North America and Europe. The study concludes that flight durations may extend, and fuel usage and emissions are likely to rise as a consequence. This could result in greater operational expenses for airlines, ultimately affecting ticket prices for passengers. Currently, turbulence results in approximately $150 million in annual costs related to aircraft damage and other factors, according to Paul Williams, a report author from the meteorology department at the University of Reading. He suggests that overall industry expenses are likely to increase with intensifying turbulence. The report is based on climate model simulations, suggesting that changes in atmospheric carbon dioxide levels will significantly increase the occurrences of turbulence experienced by air travelers. "We focused on winter conditions due to the jet stream's strength during this season, but we plan to investigate other seasons in the future," stated co-author Manoj Joshi, a climate dynamics lecturer from the University of East Anglia. Study findings indicate that the area above the North Atlantic experiencing "significant" turbulence is expected to double, Williams explained. "Significant" turbulence is defined as turbulence severe enough to necessitate the pilot activating the seat belt sign. Joshi informed CNN that similar results are anticipated for the North Pacific region between Japan and the US West Coast. Therefore, anticipate hearing the seat belt reminder more frequently during flights as air travel becomes more turbulent.

Tyrimo išvada yra tokia, kad skrydžių trukmė gali pailgėti, o degalų sąnaudos ir išmetamųjų teršalų kiekis turėtų padidėti. Tai gali padidinti oro linijų veiklos sąnaudas ir galiausiai paveikti bilietų kainas keleiviams. Šiuo metu turbulencija kasmet sukelia apie 150 milijonų dolerių nuostolių, susijusių su orlaivių pažeidimais ir kitomis išlaidomis, teigia Paulas Williamsas, ataskaitos autorius iš Redingo universiteto Meteorologijos katedros. "Mes daugiausia dėmesio skyrėme žiemos sąlygoms, nes šiuo metų laiku oro srovė yra stipriausia, tačiau ateityje planuojame ištirti ir kitus metų laikus", – sakė bendraautoris Manoj Joshi, Rytų Anglijos universiteto Klimato dinamikos lektorius. article_content: By Jack Doyle and David Tredinnick, who says astrology could help to heal the sick. The sick should turn to astrology for answers, a Tory MP has declared. David Tredinnick said astrology had a ‘proven track record’ at helping people recover from illness and should be incorporated into standard medical treatments. The MP for Bosworth in Leicestershire also admitted he had prepared astrological charts for fellow MPs – but refused to say who. ‘I am absolutely convinced that those who look at the map of the sky for the day that they were born and receive some professional guidance will find out a lot about themselves and it will make their lives easier,’ he told MPs. Speaking to the BBC this week he added: ‘I think it’s something that people should be aware of as an option they have if they are confused about themselves.’ However, he stopped short of suggesting that the NHS should provide astrological readings. He attempted to pre-empt his critics, describing them as ‘bullies’ and declaring: ‘There is no logic in attacking something that has a proven track record.’ He also revealed that Chris Patten, Britain’s last governor of Hong Kong, had an official astrologer. Mr Tredinnick is a member of two influential House of Commons committees, the health and science and technology committees. He is also vice-chairman of the Government’s herbal medicines working group.

article_content: The Nokia Lumia 900 carries significant weight for the future of Windows Phone. While previous Windows Phones were generally competent, the Lumia 900 elevates Microsoft's mobile platform considerably. It not only incorporates a super-fast LTE connection via AT&T, but it also stands as a key flagship device for both Nokia and Microsoft, at least until the arrival of Windows Phone 8 devices later this year. After using the Lumia 900 for a week, it's clear it's a remarkable smartphone. It impressively demonstrates the progress of the Windows Phone platform since its launch about eighteen months ago. Previously, quality Windows Phone apps were scarce, but it was surprisingly refreshing to find many familiar iOS apps available in the Windows Phone Marketplace. Apps like Foursquare, eBay, and Spotify are present, along with Readability, Kindle, and Pulse. Even Foodspotting is included. However, some popular apps like Instagram, Pinterest, Flipboard, and Hulu Plus are still missing. The Marketplace, recently reported to have 65,000 apps compared to the iPhone's 600,000, still needs to expand. Yet, for those not committed to another platform, it's comforting to know Windows Phone covers the essential apps. The Metro interface truly shines, especially on the Lumia 900's 4.3-inch OLED display. The increasing screen sizes of modern smartphones perfectly complement Windows Phone's Metro interface. Its design emphasizes large fonts and expansive layouts that extend to the screen edges. Windows Phone operates most effectively with ample screen space. For instance, Foursquare utilizes the space to present menus as large, clear posters. Friends, activity, and check-ins are neatly organized in columns. In contrast, the iOS and Android versions appear cramped. The integrated Metro-style design isn't consistent across all apps, and user experience may vary. Many apps from independent developers lack polish. The design can sometimes be confusing, as Metro uses symbols without labels, assuming immediate recognition, which can lead to incorrect selections, especially for new users. Caution is advised when navigating, particularly in social apps, where actions like sharing and checking in can occur unintentionally. Beyond aesthetics, usability is crucial. Windows Phone encourages touch, swipe, and pinch gestures even more than iOS or Android. The large layouts invite interaction. Here, the Lumia 900's 1.4GHz Qualcomm single-core processor performs admirably. Although single-core (due to Microsoft's initial restriction on multi-core chips for Windows Phones), it handles menu navigation smoothly. The interface feels responsive and lively to touch. In addition to the excellent UI, Nokia provides exclusive apps for Lumia owners. Nokia Drive, a free turn-by-turn navigation service using Nokia Maps (not Bing Maps), is particularly useful. Nokia has also developed visually appealing Metro-style apps for CNN and ESPN, especially for video content. The CNN app showcases Windows Phone's live tiles feature, displaying the latest top story photo on the app icon, although without a headline or context, making its meaning unclear. Regarding hardware, the phone is exceptionally well-constructed. Despite having a screen 0.8 inches larger than an iPhone, it feels comfortable to hold, partly due to the smooth yet grippy polycarbonate casing. While Nokia offers protective bumpers, the phone appears quite durable, making covers seem unnecessary. The 8-megapixel camera delivers image quality comparable to the iPhone 4S, though video recording is limited to 720p resolution. The Lumia 900's screen highlights AMOLED technology with vibrant colors and deep blacks, making icons and visuals stand out. Anti-reflection optics enhance screen visibility in bright sunlight. The LTE connection is also noteworthy. Download speeds reached up to 28.4 megabits per second in New York City's Flatiron district, significantly faster than typical office Wi-Fi at 9 Mbps and far exceeding an iPhone 4S at AT&T "4G" HSPA+ speeds of 1.9 Mbps. In conclusion, the Nokia Lumia 900, launching on April 8th for $99.99 with a contract, is undoubtedly the best Windows Phone to date. Its excellent screen perfectly complements Metro apps, and its hardware fully supports the promised user experience. This device is crucial for Microsoft to demonstrate Windows Phone's potential. While some apps like Instagram are still awaited, the Lumia 900 opens up a world of possibilities unlike anything else currently available.
translated_content: „Nokia Lumia 900“ yra labai svarbus „Windows Phone“ ateičiai. Nors ankstesni „Windows Phone“ telefonai paprastai buvo tinkami, jei ne išskirtiniai įrenginiai, „Lumia 900“ gerokai pakelia „Microsoft“ mobiliąją platformą. Jis ne tik įdiegia itin greitą LTE ryšį per AT&T, bet ir yra pagrindinis „Nokia“ ir „Microsoft“ flagmanas, bent jau iki tol, kol vėliau šiais metais pasirodys „Windows Phone 8“ įrenginiai. Jis įspūdingai demonstruoja „Windows Phone“ platformos pažangą nuo jos pasirodymo prieš maždaug aštuoniolika mėnesių. Anksčiau kokybiškų „Windows Phone“ programėlių buvo nedaug, tačiau buvo maloniai gaivu rasti daug pažįstamų „iOS“ programėlių, prieinamų „Windows Phone Marketplace“. Yra programėlės, tokios kaip „Foursquare“, „eBay“ ir „Spotify“, taip pat „Readability“, „Kindle“ ir „Pulse“. Netgi „Foodspotting“ yra įtraukta. Tačiau kai kurių populiarių programėlių, tokių kaip „Instagram“, „Pinterest“, „Flipboard“ ir „Hulu Plus“, vis dar trūksta. „Marketplace“, kuri neseniai pranešė turinti 65 000 programėlių, palyginti su „iPhone“ 600 000, vis dar turi plėstis. Vis dėlto tiems, kurie nėra įsipareigoję kitai platformai, malonu žinoti, kad „Windows Phone“ apima pagrindines programėles. „Metro“ sąsaja tikrai spindi, ypač „Lumia 900“ 4,3 colio OLED ekrane. Vis didėjantys šiuolaikinių išmaniųjų telefonų ekranų dydžiai puikiai papildo „Windows Phone“ „Metro“ sąsają. Jos dizainas pabrėžia didelius šriftus ir plačius išdėstymus, kurie tęsiasi iki ekrano kraštų. „Windows Phone“ efektyviausiai veikia, kai yra daug ekrano vietos. Pavyzdžiui, „Foursquare“ naudoja erdvę meniu pateikti kaip didelius, aiškius plakatus. Draugai, veikla ir registracijos yra tvarkingai suskirstyti į stulpelius. Priešingai, „iOS“ ir „Android“ versijos atrodo ankštos. Integruotas „Metro“ stiliaus dizainas nėra nuoseklus visose programėlėse, o naudotojo patirtis gali skirtis. Daugelis nepriklausomų kūrėjų programėlių yra nepoliruotos. Dizainas kartais gali būti painus, nes „Metro“ naudoja simbolius be etikečių, manydamas, kad jie bus iš karto atpažįstami, o tai gali lemti neteisingą pasirinkimą, ypač naujiems naudotojams. Patartina būti atsargiems naršant, ypač socialinėse programėlėse, kur veiksmai, tokie kaip dalijimasis ir registracija, gali įvykti netyčia. Be estetikos, labai svarbus yra naudojimo paprastumas. „Windows Phone“ skatina liesti, braukti ir suimti pirštais dar labiau nei „iOS“ ar „Android“. Dideli išdėstymai kviečia sąveikauti. Čia „Lumia 900“ 1,4 GHz „Qualcomm“ vieno branduolio procesorius veikia puikiai. Nors vieno branduolio (dėl pradinio „Microsoft“ apribojimo daugia branduolių lustams, skirtiems „Windows Phone“), jis sklandžiai valdo meniu navigaciją. Sąsaja jaučiasi reaguojanti ir gyva liesti. Be puikios vartotojo sąsajos, „Nokia“ teikia išskirtines programėles „Lumia“ savininkams. „Nokia Drive“, nemokama navigacijos paslauga posūkis po posūkio, naudojanti „Nokia Maps“ (ne „Bing Maps“), yra ypač naudinga. „Nokia“ taip pat sukūrė vizualiai patrauklias „Metro“ stiliaus programėles CNN ir ESPN, ypač vaizdo turiniui. CNN programėlė demonstruoja „Windows Phone“ tiesioginių plytelių funkciją, rodydama naujausios pagrindinės istorijos nuotrauką programėlės piktogramoje, nors be antraštės ar konteksto, todėl jos reikšmė neaiški. Kalbant apie aparatinę įrangą, telefonas yra ypač gerai pagamintas. Nepaisant to, kad ekranas yra 0,8 colio didesnis nei „iPhone“, jį patogu laikyti rankoje, iš dalies dėl glotnaus, bet gerai suimamo polikarbonatinio korpuso. Nors „Nokia“ siūlo apsauginius bamperius, telefonas atrodo gana patvarus, todėl dangteliai atrodo nereikalingi. 8 megapikselių kamera užtikrina vaizdo kokybę, panašią į „iPhone 4S“, nors vaizdo įrašymas apsiriboja 720p raiška. „Lumia 900“ ekranas pabrėžia AMOLED technologiją su ryškiomis spalvomis ir gilia juoda spalva, todėl piktogramos ir vaizdai išsiskiria. Antiatspindžio optika pagerina ekrano matomumą ryškioje saulės šviesoje. LTE ryšys taip pat yra pastebimas. Atsisiuntimo greitis pasiekė iki 28,4 megabitų per sekundę Niujorko Flatiron rajone, o tai gerokai greičiau nei tipinis biuro „Wi-Fi“ ryšys, siekiantis 9 Mb/s, ir gerokai viršija „iPhone 4S“ AT&T „4G“ HSPA+ greitį, siekiantį 1,9 Mb/s. Apibendrinant galima pasakyti, kad „Nokia Lumia 900“, kuris pasirodys prekyboje balandžio 8 d. už 99,99 USD su sutartimi, neabejotinai yra geriausias „Windows Phone“ iki šiol. Jo puikus ekranas puikiai papildo „Metro“ programėles, o jo aparatinė įranga visiškai palaiko pažadėtą naudotojo patirtį. Šis įrenginys yra labai svarbus „Microsoft“, norint pademonstruoti „Windows Phone“ potencialą. Nors kai kurių programėlių, tokių kaip „Instagram“, vis dar laukiama, „Lumia 900“ atveria galimybių pasaulį, nepanašų į nieką kitą, kas šiuo metu yra prieinama.

article_content: Following the recent release of what’s been called the final Beatles song, a woman from Halifax shares her story of how the Fab Four secretly stayed at her family home 59 years ago, after a concert. Gail Moss recalls the excitement of “every teenager in West Yorkshire” when the Beatles visited Bradford to begin their autumn 1964 UK tour. For Gail, then 14, the event was even more special. Around 11 PM GMT on Friday, October 9, 1964, George Harrison, John Lennon, Paul McCartney, and Ringo Starr arrived at her Halifax residence. The Beatles, already famous with three albums and five No. 1 hits, needed a private place to stay after performing at Bradford’s Gaumont Cinema to avoid pursuing fans. Gail’s father, Freddie Pearson, knew someone connected to Beatles manager Brian Epstein and offered their Jacobean manor, Holdsworth House, where he had opened a private club the previous year. Her mother, Rita, worried about their garden being “trampled by thousands of screaming fans,” but police roadblocks ensured the band could secretly leave the venue and reach Holdsworth House. Upon arrival, the band chatted with guests at the bar before having dinner in an upstairs room. The meal included trout, turtle soup, cold duckling, and steak tartare – a “rather rich selection,” according to Gail. After dinner, they returned to the bar where Harrison, McCartney, Starr, and Epstein stayed up drinking until the early hours. Lennon, celebrating his 24th birthday, went to bed early due to toothache, but not before entertaining everyone with jokes, including an impersonation of a pompous Yorkshire mill owner. The Beatles’ stay meant Gail and her eight-year-old sister Kim had to give up their bedroom for the night. “John and Ringo slept in our room, and Paul and George slept in my parents’ room. We all shared the bathroom down the corridor,” Gail told BBC Radio Leeds. Gail woke up at 6 AM the next morning, eager to meet the band before their departure. However, they were not early risers. “They didn’t come down for breakfast on Saturday morning, and at 11 AM they were still in their rooms,” Gail remembered. “I was in tears, thinking I would never meet them. My mother eventually knocked on their door and said her daughter was waiting to see them.” Gail felt “mortified” by her mother’s intervention but found the band “absolutely charming.” She recalled her sister hiding behind a curtain, and “Ringo went to find her and bring her out,” being “very sweet with her.” McCartney even offered Gail a cigarette, “which I didn’t take, but could probably have sold for a lot of money,” she added. The brass beds where Starr and Lennon slept are still at Holdsworth House, now a hotel, along with other Beatles memorabilia. These include a signed menu and the band’s £2 15s bar bill, on which the head waiter misspelled their name as “Beetles.” The Beatles’ visit provided Gail with a memorable story. She laughed, “When I returned to school on Monday, everyone was furious because I hadn’t told them.” Follow BBC Yorkshire on Facebook, X (formerly Twitter), and Instagram. Gail Moss prisimena „kiekvieno paauglio Vakarų Jorkšyre“ jaudulį, kai „The Beatles“ atvyko į Bradfordą pradėti savo 1964 m. rudens turo po JK. Gail, tuo metu 14 metų, šis įvykis buvo dar ypatingesnis. Apie 23:00 Grinvičo laiku 1964 m. spalio 9 d., penktadienį, George Harrison, John Lennon, Paul McCartney ir Ringo Starr atvyko į jos namus Halifakse. „The Beatles“, jau garsūs su trimis albumais ir penkiais pirmojo numerio hitais, reikėjo privačios vietos apsistoti po pasirodymo Bradfordo „Gaumont“ kino teatre, kad išvengtų gerbėjų persekiojimo. Jos mama Rita nerimavo, kad jų sodą „sumindžios tūkstančiai rėkiančių gerbėjų“, tačiau policijos užtvaros užtikrino, kad grupė galėtų slapta išvykti iš renginio vietos ir pasiekti „Holdsworth House“. Atvykę grupės nariai pabendravo su svečiais bare, o vėliau vakarieniavo viršutiniame kambaryje. Vakarienę sudarė upėtakis, vėžlių sriuba, šalta antiena ir tartar bifštekas – „gana prabangus pasirinkimas“, pasak Gail. Po vakarienės jie grįžo į barą, kur Harrisonas, McCartney, Starras ir Epsteinas gėrė iki ankstyvo ryto. Lennonas, šventęs savo 24-ąjį gimtadienį, dėl dantų skausmo anksti nuėjo miegoti, bet prieš tai prajuokino visus pokštais, įskaitant išsipūtusio Jorkšyro malūno savininko parodiją. „The Beatles“ apsistojimas reiškė, kad Gail ir jos aštuonerių metų sesuo Kim turėjo atlaisvinti savo miegamąjį nakčiai. „Johnas ir Ringo miegojo mūsų kambaryje, o Paulas ir Georgeas miegojo mano tėvų kambaryje. Mes visi naudojomės tuo pačiu vonios kambariu koridoriuje“, – BBC Radio Leeds sakė Gail. Gail pabudo 6 val. ryto, nekantraudama susitikti su grupe prieš jiems išvykstant. Tačiau jie nebuvo ankstyvi ryto žmonės. „Jie nenusileido pusryčiauti šeštadienio rytą, o 11 val. ryto jie vis dar buvo savo kambariuose“, – prisiminė Gail. „Aš verkiau, galvodama, kad niekada jų nesutiksiu. Galiausiai mano mama pasibeldė į jų duris ir pasakė, kad jos dukra laukia, kad juos pamatytų.“ Gail jautėsi „sugėdinta“ dėl savo mamos įsikišimo, bet grupė jai pasirodė „absoliučiai žavinga“. Ji prisiminė, kaip jos sesuo pasislėpė už užuolaidos, o „Ringo nuėjo jos ieškoti ir ištraukė“, būdamas „labai mielas su ja“. McCartney net pasiūlė Gail cigaretę, „kurios aš nepriėmiau, bet tikriausiai būčiau galėjusi parduoti už didelius pinigus“, – pridūrė ji. Bronzinės lovos, kuriose miegojo Starras ir Lennonas, vis dar yra „Holdsworth House“, dabar viešbutyje, kartu su kitais „The Beatles“ relikvijomis. Tarp jų yra pasirašytas meniu ir grupės 2 svarų sterlingų ir 15 šilingų baro sąskaita, ant kurios vyriausiasis padavėjas jų pavadinimą parašė kaip „Beetles“ (vabalai). „The Beatles“ vizitas padovanojo Gail įsimintiną istoriją. article_content: Research indicates that toddlers often have trouble falling asleep because their bedtime is set too early, before their bodies are prepared for rest. Scientists in the United States discovered that the primary reason toddlers can't sleep is that they are frequently sent to bed prematurely, before their internal body clock is ready.  Putting young children to bed too early, although it might seem beneficial for parents seeking a quiet evening, can actually cause toddlers to lie awake for extended periods. This can lead them to associate bedtime with being alert rather than with sleepiness, researchers caution.  Toddlers put to bed before they are ready may resist going to bed, become upset, and repeatedly get out of bed, a behavior the study refers to as 'curtain calls'. These 'curtain calls' involve toddlers constantly leaving their beds and going downstairs or into their parents' room, according to researchers at the University of Colorado, Boulder.  The study, featured in the journal 'Mind, Brain and Education', highlights that a good night's sleep for toddlers is linked to the timing of the rise in melatonin, a hormone that increases in the evening and regulates the body's internal clock. Factors such as light exposure and a child's individual biology influence when melatonin levels are optimal, and this varies among children.  Researchers emphasize that sleep problems for both toddlers and their parents are often caused by choosing a bedtime that doesn't match the child's biological clock.  They also cautioned that persistent sleep problems in toddlerhood could contribute to emotional and behavioral issues later in life.  The researchers studied 14 toddlers, aged between 30 and 36 months, over six consecutive nights. They measured melatonin levels at different times around bedtime, tracked how long it took them to fall asleep, and observed their behavior.  The study found that, on average, melatonin levels began to rise around 7:40 pm. When parents waited about half an hour after this melatonin rise to put their children to bed, the toddlers typically fell asleep within 30 minutes. However, toddlers with later melatonin rises who were put to bed earlier took longer to fall asleep and were more likely to get out of bed or misbehave.  Associate Professor Monique LeBourgeois, a physiologist who led the study, explained that sleeping at the wrong 'biological clock' time causes sleep issues, such as insomnia, in adults. While adults can choose their bedtime, toddlers usually don't have this choice.  She added that when there is a mismatch between parent-chosen bedtimes and the toddler's natural evening melatonin production, it increases the chances of nighttime sleep problems.  The report concluded that toddlers who had a longer period between the start of their nightly melatonin release and their bedtime fell asleep faster and showed less bedtime resistance, as reported by their parents. Essentially, the more tired a toddler is when they go to bed, the more likely they are to sleep well.  Professor LeBourgeois suggested that if a child is fighting bedtime or struggling to fall asleep, it's probably because they are not physiologically ready to sleep at that time. For these children, lying awake in bed for too long can make them associate bed with being awake and alert, not with sleep. This kind of response could increase a child's long-term risk of developing insomnia.
translated_content: Tyrimai rodo, kad mažiems vaikams dažnai sunku užmigti, nes jų miegas nustatomas per anksti, dar nepasiruošus jų organizmui poilsiui. Jungtinių Valstijų mokslininkai nustatė, kad pagrindinė priežastis, kodėl mažyliai negali miegoti, yra ta, kad jie dažnai guldomi per anksti, kol jų vidinis laikrodis dar nepasiruošęs.  Per anksti guldyti mažus vaikus, nors tėvams, ieškantiems ramaus vakaro, tai gali atrodyti naudinga, iš tikrųjų gali priversti mažylius ilgai gulėti nemiegojusius. Tai gali paskatinti juos sieti lovą su budrumu, o ne su mieguistumu, perspėja tyrėjai.  Mažyliai, paguldyti į lovą anksčiau, nei yra pasiruošę, gali priešintis miegui, supykti ir nuolat lipti iš lovos – tokį elgesį tyrimas vadina „užuolaidų pakėlimu“. Pasak Kolorado universiteto Boulderyje tyrėjų, „užuolaidų pakėlimas“ – tai nuolatinis mažylių išlipimas iš lovos ir ėjimas žemyn arba į tėvų miegamąjį.  Žurnale „Mind, Brain and Education“ paskelbtame tyrime pabrėžiama, kad geras mažylių miegas priklauso nuo melatonino – hormono, kuris vakare didėja ir reguliuoja organizmo vidinį laikrodį – padidėjimo laiko. Tokie veiksniai kaip šviesos poveikis ir individuali vaiko biologija lemia, kada melatonino lygis yra optimalus, ir kiekvienam vaikui tai skiriasi.  Tyrėjai pabrėžia, kad miego problemos tiek mažyliams, tiek jų tėvams dažnai kyla dėl to, kad miegas pasirenkamas neatsižvelgiant į vaiko biologinį laikrodį.  Jie taip pat įspėjo, kad nuolatinės miego problemos vaikystėje gali prisidėti prie emocinių ir elgesio problemų vėlesniame gyvenime.  Tyrėjai šešias naktis iš eilės tyrė 14 mažylių, kurių amžius buvo nuo 30 iki 36 mėnesių. Jie matavo melatonino lygį įvairiais laikotarpiais prieš miegą, fiksavo, kiek laiko užtrunka užmigti, ir stebėjo jų elgesį.  Tyrimas parodė, kad vidutiniškai melatonino lygis pradeda kilti apie 19:40 val. Kai tėvai palaukia maždaug pusvalandį po šio melatonino padidėjimo ir paguldo vaikus į lovą, mažyliai dažniausiai užmiega per 30 minučių. Tačiau mažyliai, kuriems melatonino lygis pakyla vėliau ir kurie paguldomi anksčiau, užmiega ilgiau ir dažniau lipa iš lovos ar blogai elgiasi.  Tyrimui vadovavusi fiziologė docentė Monique LeBourgeois paaiškino, kad miegas netinkamu „biologinio laikrodžio“ laiku sukelia miego problemų, pavyzdžiui, nemigą, suaugusiesiems. Nors suaugusieji gali pasirinkti, kada eiti miegoti, mažyliai dažniausiai tokios galimybės neturi.  Ji pridūrė, kad neatitikimas tarp tėvų parinkto miego laiko ir natūralios vakarinės mažylio melatonino gamybos padidina nakties miego problemų tikimybę.  Ataskaitoje teigiama, kad mažyliai, kurių laikotarpis tarp naktinio melatonino išsiskyrimo pradžios ir miego buvo ilgesnis, užmiega greičiau ir, tėvų teigimu, mažiau priešinasi miegui. Iš esmės, kuo mažylis pavargęs eidamas miegoti, tuo didesnė tikimybė, kad jis gerai miegos.  Profesorė LeBourgeois patarė, kad jei vaikas priešinasi miegui arba jam sunku užmigti, greičiausiai jis fiziologiškai nėra pasiruošęs miegoti tuo metu. Tokiems vaikams per ilgai gulėti lovoje nemiegojus gali priversti juos sieti lovą su budrumu, o ne su miegu. Tokia reakcija ilgainiui gali padidinti vaiko riziką susirgti nemiga.

article_content: Samantha Green, a 29-year-old leukaemia survivor, experienced hair loss and was refused NHS funding for hair replacement therapy. After MailOnline reported her situation, hair expert Lucinda Ellery provided the treatment at no cost. Green developed alopecia following her second battle with leukaemia. Despite applying three times, the NHS declined to fund the £2,000 hair replacement, deeming her case not 'exceptional'. Lucinda Ellery, upon reading about Green in MailOnline, offered to perform the Intralace hair replacement procedure for free. Green, a mother to an eight-year-old, expressed immense happiness with her new hair after the procedure. She described feeling 'speechless' and 'emotional' upon receiving Ellery's offer. Green praised the treatment, saying it felt natural and expressing gratitude to MailOnline and Ellery. The Intralace system, designed for significant hair loss, uses a breathable mesh integrated with existing hair. It doesn't require shaving and is suitable for managing hair loss and regrowth post-treatment. The system involves attaching mesh panels with human hair and adding a parting for a natural look. It allows for normal activities like sports and hair care. Green's daughter Madison enjoys styling her new hair. Green, formerly training to be a nurse, was diagnosed with leukaemia in 2005, relapsing in 2010. She believes Busulfan, a chemotherapy drug, caused her alopecia. The Central Midlands Commissioning Support Unit considered her case non-exceptional, which Green found disheartening. She contrasted this with breast reconstruction for mastectomy patients, arguing for similar consideration for alopecia sufferers due to chemotherapy. MailOnline's report sparked reader outrage, leading to Ellery's offer. The Intralace system lasts two years, using a mesh to integrate additional hair without stressing existing strands. Green received the treatment in London, finding the staff 'lovely and friendly'. Green disliked her wig due to discomfort and self-consciousness. She is now excited to leave the wig behind and feels more confident. Green looks forward to her 30th birthday with her new hair. Dr Dan De Rosa of Wolverhampton Clinical Commissioning Group stated funding decisions are based on local needs and fairness. Reader comments on MailOnline criticized NHS priorities, questioning funding for cosmetic procedures over illness-related conditions.

Green gydymas buvo atliktas Londone, o personalas jai pasirodė „mielas ir draugiškas“. Green nemėgo savo peruko dėl diskomforto ir savimonės. article_content: In Jerusalem, Israel, a judge found former Prime Minister Ehud Olmert guilty of bribery on Monday. The Tel Aviv District Court Judge, David Rosen, convicted Olmert of accepting approximately $161,000 in bribes. These bribes were connected to the Holyland project, a contentious housing development in Jerusalem.  Although acquitted on one bribery charge, he was convicted on another. Hillel Cherney, the Holyland developer, had already been convicted of bribing Olmert and other officials to secure approvals for the project. Olmert served as Jerusalem's mayor from 1993 to 2003 and later as Prime Minister from 2006 to 2009. His sentencing is set for April 28.  Olmert, a lawyer, became the youngest Knesset member in 1973. He resigned as prime minister shortly after police recommended corruption charges. In August 2012, he was convicted of breach of trust and acquitted of two other corruption charges following a nearly three-year trial.  He received a 3-month suspended jail sentence and a fine of about $19,000 in that earlier case. The allegations spanned his time as both mayor and prime minister. Prosecutors accused him of double-billing government agencies for travel, accepting cash for favors from an American businessman, and acting on behalf of his former law partner's clients.

article_content: Los Angeles (CNN) -- Orange is the new black for Chris Brown. Chris Brown's lawyer was unable to persuade a Los Angeles judge on Monday to release the singer from jail. Brown, 24, appeared in court wearing an orange jail jumpsuit, with his mother present, while attorney Mark Geragos argued that the singer should be allowed to enter another rehabilitation program instead of serving the next month in jail. The singer was jailed on a probation violation warrant on Friday after being expelled from a court-ordered drug rehabilitation program. Assistant District Attorney Mary Murray stated that Brown has already been removed from two rehabilitation programs in the past five months, and another program should not be considered. Los Angeles County Superior Court Judge James Brandlin expressed concern about a "provocative" statement that counselors reported Brown wrote on a card at the Malibu rehabilitation center. "I am good at using guns and knives," according to court documents read aloud. The rehabilitation program cited this statement and two other rule violations as reasons for Brown's dismissal, the documents indicated. Brown allegedly refused a drug test -- which his lawyer denied -- and touched elbows with a female patient, according to the document. Brown's next opportunity for release is on April 23, when Judge Brandlin will consider whether his arrest on a misdemeanor assault charge in Washington justifies his continued imprisonment. There is a possibility that the judge will expedite this decision so Brown can travel to D.C. for a trial on that charge. Brown's legal troubles began five years ago when he assaulted Rihanna while they were in a rented Lamborghini on a Hollywood street. He pleaded guilty to felony assault in June 2009, resulting in a sentence of five years of probation and 1,400 hours of community service. The judge has revoked Brown's probation twice in the past year, most recently due to his arrest near the White House after he allegedly punched a man. Brown voluntarily entered a rehabilitation program a day after being released from a Washington jail in October, but he was expelled a few days later for "throwing a rock through his mother's car window" after a family session at the center, according to a probation report. The report stated that Brown was upset because his mother expressed her desire for him to remain in treatment. "Mr. Brown proceeded to walk outside, pick up a rock, and throw it through his mother's car window, shattering it," according to a letter from the rehabilitation center included in the probation report. His probation was revoked in November, but the judge allowed him to avoid jail by entering a 90-day anger management and drug rehabilitation program. Although he completed that program last month, the judge ordered him to remain a resident at the Malibu treatment facility until a hearing on April 23. Brown's probation officer reported at a hearing last month that the singer "continues to make great improvement" in managing anger, stress, and drug issues, but the judge decided he could not be released until after his trial for the assault charge in Washington on April 17. If convicted in that case, the judge would decide on April 23 whether Brown should complete his probation in jail. Brown has been working on a highway cleanup labor crew in Los Angeles three days a week to fulfill the remaining 750 hours of service in his probation requirements, his probation report stated. At that rate, Brown could complete the labor by mid-October and potentially be free from probation requirements by the end of the year. However, time served in jail does not count towards probation. CNN's Topher Gauk-Roger and Carolyn Sung contributed to this report.
translated_content: Los Andželas (CNN) -- Oranžinė spalva – nauja Chriso Browno juoda. Chriso Browno advokatui pirmadienį nepavyko įtikinti Los Andželo teisėjo paleisti dainininką iš kalėjimo. 24 metų Brownas teisme pasirodė vilkėdamas oranžinį kalėjimo kombinezoną, o jo motina sėdėjo už jo, tuo tarpu advokatas Markas Geragosas tvirtino, kad dainininkui turėtų būti leista stoti į kitą reabilitacijos programą, o ne praleisti kitą mėnesį kalėjime. Dainininkas buvo įkalintas pagal probacijos pažeidimo orderį penktadienį po to, kai buvo išmestas iš teismo nurodytos reabilitacijos nuo narkotikų programos. Apygardos prokuroro padėjėja Mary Murray pareiškė, kad Brownas jau buvo pašalintas iš dviejų reabilitacijos programų per pastaruosius penkis mėnesius ir dar viena programa neturėtų būti svarstoma. Los Andželo apygardos aukštesniojo teismo teisėjas Jamesas Brandlinas išreiškė susirūpinimą dėl „provokuojančio“ pareiškimo, kurį, kaip pranešė konsultantai, Brownas parašė ant kortelės Malibu reabilitacijos centre. „Man gerai sekasi naudoti ginklus ir peilius“, – teigiama teismo dokumentuose, kurie buvo perskaityti teisme. Reabilitacijos programa nurodė Brownui išvykti dėl šio pareiškimo ir dar dviejų taisyklių pažeidimų, nurodoma dokumentuose. Teigiama, kad Brownas atsisakė atlikti narkotikų testą – ką jo advokatas paneigė – ir palietė alkūnėmis moterį pacientę, teigiama dokumente. Browno kita galimybė išeiti iš kalėjimo bus balandžio 23 d., kai teisėjas Brandlinas svarstys, ar jo areštas dėl kaltinimų užpuolimu Vašingtone pateisina jo tolesnį įkalinimą. Yra galimybė, kad teisėjas paspartins šį sprendimą, kad Brownas galėtų nuvykti į D.C. į teismą dėl šio kaltinimo. Browno teisinės problemos prasidėjo prieš penkerius metus, kai jis užpuolė Rihanną, kai jie sėdėjo išsinuomotame „Lamborghini“ Holivudo gatvėje. Jis prisipažino kaltu dėl sunkaus kūno sužalojimo 2009 m. birželį, dėl ko buvo nuteistas penkeriems metams lygtinai ir 1400 valandų viešųjų darbų. Teisėjas per pastaruosius metus du kartus panaikino Browno probaciją, paskutinį kartą dėl jo arešto netoli Baltųjų rūmų po to, kai jis tariamai smogė vyrui. Brownas savo noru stojo į reabilitacijos programą praėjus dienai po to, kai buvo paleistas iš Vašingtono kalėjimo spalį, tačiau po kelių dienų buvo išmestas už tai, kad „metė akmenį į savo motinos automobilio langą“ po šeimos sesijos centre, teigiama probacijos ataskaitoje. Ataskaitoje teigiama, kad Brownas buvo nusiminęs, nes jo motina išreiškė norą, kad jis liktų gydytis. „Ponas Brownas nuėjo laukan, pakėlė akmenį ir metė jį į savo motinos automobilio langą, jį sudaužydamas“, – teigiama reabilitacijos centro laiške, įtrauktame į probacijos ataskaitą. Jo probacija buvo panaikinta lapkritį, tačiau teisėjas leido jam išvengti kalėjimo, stojant į 90 dienų pykčio valdymo ir reabilitacijos nuo narkotikų programą. Nors jis praėjusį mėnesį baigė šią programą, teisėjas nurodė jam likti Malibu gydymo įstaigos gyventoju iki balandžio 23 d. posėdžio. Browno probacijos pareigūnas praėjusio mėnesio posėdyje pranešė, kad dainininkas „ir toliau labai tobulėja“ valdydamas pyktį, stresą ir narkotikų problemas, tačiau teisėjas nusprendė, kad jis negali būti paleistas iki teismo dėl kaltinimų užpuolimu Vašingtone balandžio 17 d. Jei jis bus nuteistas šioje byloje, teisėjas balandžio 23 d. nuspręs, ar Brownas turėtų atlikti probaciją kalėjime. Brownas dirba greitkelių valymo komandoje Los Andžele tris dienas per savaitę, kad atliktų likusias 750 valandų viešųjų darbų pagal savo probacijos reikalavimus, teigiama jo probacijos ataskaitoje. Tokiu tempu Brownas galėtų baigti darbus iki spalio vidurio ir galbūt būti atleistas nuo probacijos reikalavimų iki metų pabaigos. Tačiau kalėjime praleistas laikas neįskaitomas į probacijos laiką. CNN darbuotojai Topher Gauk-Roger ir Carolyn Sung prisidėjo prie šio pranešimo.

article_content: A 37-year-old man tragically died after collapsing upon opening a container labeled ‘Pandora’s Box’, an inquest heard. Jason Airey was discovered unconscious by his parents next to the box in his bedroom at their Carlisle, Cumbria home. The box contained unused synthetic cannabis. Notably, no drugs were detected in his system. Mr. Airey’s heart ceased beating, leading to organ failure. He passed away two days later at Cumberland Infirmary, never regaining consciousness after collapsing in May. The container was described with the words ‘Pandora’s Box’ in red letters. In Greek mythology, Pandora’s Box was given by Zeus with a warning not to open it, but curiosity led her to release miseries and evils upon mankind. Mr. Airey had been employed by food manufacturer Cavaghan and Gray, and construction firm Metal Box, both located in Carlisle. His father, Dennis, testified at the inquest that Jason was happy on May 2nd, stating, ‘He was his normal self. He seemed to have enjoyed a trip to town for shopping and mentioned he was going upstairs to change.’ Mr. Airey Snr recounted his wife Anne’s concern when Jason remained upstairs for an extended period. ‘She went to check on him and returned saying something was wrong. She couldn’t wake him,’ he added. Paramedics were summoned, and Mr. Airey Snr initiated CPR. According to reports, paramedics worked on Jason for an hour before transporting him to the hospital. Coroner Robert Chapman stated, ‘His heart stopping caused the death of his brain, which in turn led to multiple organ failure.  The cause of his heart stopping remains unknown.’ Mr. Airey’s father found ‘a small packet’ inside the box, initially mistaking it for cannabis due to appearance, but noted ‘it had no smell’. Tests confirmed it was synthetic cannabis, unused and found on the bed beside Jason. Mr. Airey Snr clarified his son had abstained from drugs since a negative experience with ecstasy 13 years prior. Ruling that the death was due to natural causes in the sense of an unexplained medical event, Coroner Robert Chapman reiterated, ‘His heart stopping caused brain death and subsequent multiple organ failure. The underlying reason for his heart stopping remains unknown.’ The myth of Pandora, Epimetheus, and Prometheus involves Zeus punishing them for giving fire to humans. Zeus created Pandora and offered her to Prometheus, who refused her, suspecting divine retribution. Epimetheus, however, was captivated by her beauty and married her. Pandora received the forbidden box from Zeus. Upon opening it, evils escaped, stinging her like moths. Quickly closing it, only hope remained inside, offering healing. Thus, Pandora unleashed suffering but also hope into the world.

Džeisonas Airis buvo rastas be sąmonės miegamajame, jo tėvų namuose Karlailo mieste, Kambrijoje, šalia dėžės. Dėžėje buvo nenaudotas sintetinis kanabis. Pažymėtina, kad jo organizme narkotikų nerasta. Pono Airio širdis nustojo plakti, dėl to sutriko organų veikla. Jis mirė po dviejų dienų Kamberlando ligoninėje, taip ir neatgavęs sąmonės po to, kai gegužę prarado sąmonę. Konteineris buvo aprašytas raudonomis raidėmis „Pandoros skrynia“. Graikų mitologijoje Pandoros skrynią davė Dzeusas, įspėdamas jos neatidaryti, tačiau smalsumas paskatino ją išleisti kančias ir blogį žmonijai. Ponas Airis dirbo maisto gamybos įmonėje „Cavaghan and Gray“ ir statybos įmonėje „Metal Box“, abi įsikūrusios Karlailo mieste. Jo tėvas Denisas teismo medicinos tyrime paliudijo, kad gegužės 2-ąją Džeisonas buvo laimingas, sakydamas: „Jis buvo toks, koks visada. Atrodė, kad jam patiko apsipirkti mieste ir jis sakė, kad eis į viršų persirengti.“ Ponas Airis vyresnysis papasakojo apie savo žmonos Anos susirūpinimą, kai Džeisonas ilgą laiką užtruko viršuje. „Ji nuėjo jo patikrinti ir grįžo sakydama, kad kažkas negerai. Ji negalėjo jo pažadinti“, – pridūrė jis. Buvo iškviesti paramedikai, o ponas Airis vyresnysis pradėjo gaivinimą. Pranešama, kad paramedikai su Džeisonu dirbo valandą prieš transportuodami jį į ligoninę. Koroneris Robertas Čepmenas pareiškė: „Jo širdies sustojimas sukėlė smegenų mirtį, o tai savo ruožtu sukėlė daugybinį organų nepakankamumą. Mes nežinome, kodėl jo širdis sustojo.“ Pono Airio tėvas dėžėje rado „mažą paketėlį“, iš pradžių palaikęs jį kanapėmis dėl išvaizdos, tačiau pastebėjo, kad „jis neturi kvapo“. Tyrimai patvirtino, kad tai sintetinis kanabis, nenaudotas ir rastas ant lovos šalia Džeisono. Ponas Airis vyresnysis paaiškino, kad jo sūnus susilaikė nuo narkotikų po neigiamos patirties su ekstaziu prieš 13 metų. Pripažindamas, kad mirtis buvo natūrali dėl nepaaiškinamo medicininio įvykio, koroneris Robertas Čepmenas pakartojo: „Jo širdies sustojimas sukėlė smegenų mirtį ir vėlesnį daugybinį organų nepakankamumą. Pagrindinė jo širdies sustojimo priežastis lieka nežinoma.“ Pandoros, Epimetėjo ir Prometėjo mitas pasakoja apie Dzeusą, baudžiantį juos už ugnies davimą žmonėms. Dzeusas sukūrė Pandorą ir pasiūlė ją Prometėjui, kuris jos atsisakė, įtardamas dievišką bausmę. Tačiau Epimetėjui ji pasirodė graži ir jis ją vedė. Pandora gavo uždraustą dėžę iš Dzeuso. Ją atidarius, išsiliejo blogybės, geliančios ją kaip kandys. Greitai ją uždarius, viduje liko tik viltis, siūlanti išgydymą. Taigi Pandora į pasaulį paleido kančias, bet ir viltį.

article_content: Unscripted photographs of Anzac soldiers at Gallipoli vividly depict the authentic realities of wartime. To mark the centennial of World War I, the Australian War Memorial has unveiled 39 images as part of a travelling exhibition. These photographs were captured by Sir Charles Ryan, a prominent Melbourne surgeon, during his service with the Australian Imperial Force in Turkey in 1915. Scroll down to view the video. Sir Charles Ryan, the Melbourne-based surgeon who captured candid images of soldiers in World War I, is pictured outside the Aide-de-Camp dugout at Gallipoli in 1915. This photograph of Brigadier General Carruthers, a British officer, illustrates the harsh and unforgiving conditions endured by Anzac troops. According to Dr Brendan Nelson, director of the Australian War Memorial, the exhibition, titled 'A Camera on Gallipoli', reveals the true story of the 1915 Gallipoli campaign. He explained that in 1914, at the age of 61, Sir Charles Ryan was appointed consulting surgeon to the AIF. He departed from Melbourne in October, heading to the Middle East and then Gallipoli. Dr Nelson stated that Sir Charles Ryan’s photographs capture the genuine experiences of Australians in war, portraying the arid, desolate landscape, weary soldiers in trenches, and unsanitary dugouts. Dr Nelson emphasized that while the images depict the harsh realities of war, they also showcase the 'true spirit of the Australian soldiers who fought at Gallipoli'. He added that 'their camaraderie, resilience, and fortitude are evident in these photographs and embody the essence of the Anzac spirit'. Dr Nelson further noted that Dr Ryan had served as a doctor with the Turkish army from 1877 to 1878, treated Ned Kelly in Glenrowan, northeast of Melbourne, and had a distinguished career as a senior military officer. 'He received significant civil and military recognition from his contemporaries,' Dr Nelson commented. The photographs will be presented in three formats: a framed exhibition, a portable banner exhibition, and a digital exhibition. They will tour across NSW from August to October. translated_content: Neišgalvotos Anzac karių nuotraukos Galipolyje ryškiai atspindi tikrą karo realybę. Minint Pirmojo pasaulinio karo šimtmetį, Australijos karo memorialas pristatė 39 nuotraukas kaip keliaujančios parodos dalį. Šias nuotraukas 1915 m. Turkijoje tarnybos Australijos imperinėse pajėgose metu padarė seras Charlesas Ryanas, žymus Melburno chirurgas. Slinkite žemyn, norėdami pamatyti vaizdo įrašą. Seras Charlesas Ryanas, Melburne įsikūręs chirurgas, kuris užfiksavo atviras kareivių Pirmojo pasaulinio karo nuotraukas, yra nufotografuotas prie Aide-de-Camp bunkerio Galipolyje 1915 m. Ši brigados generolo Carrutherso, britų karininko, nuotrauka iliustruoja atšiaurias ir negailestingas sąlygas, kurias turėjo ištverti Anzac kariai. Pasak Australijos karo memorialo direktoriaus daktaro Brendano Nelsono, paroda „Kamera Galipolyje“ atskleidžia tikrąją 1915 m. Galipolio kampanijos istoriją. Jis paaiškino, kad 1914 m., būdamas 61 metų, seras Charlesas Ryanas buvo paskirtas AIF konsultuojančiu chirurgu. Spalį jis išvyko iš Melburno, vyko į Artimuosius Rytus ir paskui į Galipolį. Daktaras Nelsonas pareiškė, kad sero Charleso Ryano nuotraukos užfiksuoja tikrą australų patirtį kare, vaizduodamos sausą, apleistą kraštovaizdį, pavargusius kareivius apkasuose ir antisanitarinius bunkerius. Daktaras Nelsonas pabrėžė, kad nors nuotraukos atspindi atšiaurią karo realybę, jos taip pat demonstruoja „tikrąją Australijos kareivių, kovojusių Galipolyje, dvasią“. Jis pridūrė, kad „jų draugystė, atsparumas ir tvirtybė yra akivaizdūs šiose nuotraukose ir įkūnija Anzac dvasios esmę“. Daktaras Nelsonas toliau pažymėjo, kad daktaras Ryanas 1877–1878 m. tarnavo gydytoju Turkijos kariuomenėje, gydė Nedą Kelly Glenrovane, šiaurės rytų Melburne, ir turėjo išskirtinę vyresniojo karininko karjerą. „Jis sulaukė didelio pilietinio ir karinio pripažinimo iš savo amžininkų“, – komentavo daktaras Nelsonas. Nuotraukos bus pristatytos trimis formatais: įrėminta paroda, nešiojama stendinė paroda ir skaitmeninė paroda. Jos keliaus po Naująjį Pietų Velsą (NSW) nuo rugpjūčio iki spalio mėnesio. Norėdami gauti daugiau informacijos, spustelėkite čia. Du kariai iš tiekimo depo, Pirmasis Australijos divizionas, stovi tarp sukrautų konservuotos jautienos ir konservuotos mėsos dėžių. Priekiniame plane matomos benzino ar vandens kanistrų eilės. Kareiviai ruošiasi transportuoti vandenį ir kitus reikmenis į fronto linijas.

article_content: Media giant Warner Bros. Discovery has voiced its opinion that current British regulations limiting how long distributors can mandate cinemas to show their movies might be 'no longer relevant'. The company suggests it’s time for the British government to rethink and possibly eliminate this legislation. The long-standing Exhibition Periods law, formalized in 1996, restricts distributors from requiring cinemas to screen a film for more than two weeks within the initial six weeks of its cinema release. Warner Bros. contends that with the shift to digital film distribution and greater flexibility for cinemas in scheduling screenings, this law may have lost its purpose. They argue that getting rid of it could unlock new income opportunities for distributors. These comments were submitted in writing to the UK Parliament’s Culture, Media, and Sport Committee, which is currently investigating the state of high-quality film and television. Warner Bros. elaborated that removing this restriction could boost confidence and incentive for distributors, including those handling independent British films, to release films in cinemas. This is because they might be able to negotiate longer screening periods with individual cinemas. They further explained that since most films typically earn the majority of their ticket sales in the first month of release, having the chance to secure an additional two weeks of cinema run could significantly influence whether some films get a theatrical release at all, or if increased spending on publicity and advertising becomes justifiable. In other parts of their submission, Warner Bros. highlighted the economic impact of Greta Gerwig’s blockbuster 'Barbie', noting it as their most commercially successful cinema release ever. The film injected over £80 million directly into the local UK economy and generated 685 jobs during its UK production at Warner Bros. Studios Leavesden, near London. 'Barbie' has grossed £95 million at the UK box office. The Culture, Media, and Sport Committee received over 130 written submissions from across the film industry, including major studios like Paramount and Amazon, as well as organizations like the British Film Institute and Pact. Pact, representing UK producers, concluded in their submission that the UK’s independent film industry is currently facing 'market failure'. Pact stated that a combination of tough market conditions, rising costs for talent and crew, and evolving audience viewing habits have made it increasingly challenging for independent films to compete with high-end TV and big-budget studio films from the US. Pact also attributed the decline in the UK independent sector to factors like the slow return of audiences to cinemas. They recommended increasing tax relief to 40% for films with budgets between £1 million and £15 million, up from the current 25%. Pact warned that without urgent action from the government, the independent film sector’s viability is at risk, which would negatively impact talent development and jobs within the sector and the broader audiovisual industry.

Discovery“ pareiškė nuomonę, kad dabartiniai Didžiosios Britanijos įstatymai, ribojantys laikotarpį, kurį platintojai gali reikalauti, kad kino teatrai rodytų jų filmus, gali būti „nebeaktualūs“. Bendrovė siūlo Didžiosios Britanijos vyriausybei iš naujo apsvarstyti ir galbūt panaikinti šį įstatymą. Ilgalaikis Kino rodymo laikotarpių įstatymas, oficialiai įteisintas 1996 m., riboja platintojų galimybes reikalauti, kad kino teatrai rodytų filmą ilgiau nei dvi savaites per pirmąsias šešias jo išleidimo kino teatruose savaites. „Warner Bros.“ teigia, kad, pereinant prie skaitmeninio filmų platinimo ir kino teatrams suteikiant daugiau lankstumo planuojant seansus, šis įstatymas galėjo prarasti savo prasmę. Jie argumentuoja, kad jo panaikinimas galėtų atverti naujų pajamų galimybių platintojams. Šios pastabos buvo pateiktos raštu JK Parlamento Kultūros, žiniasklaidos ir sporto komitetui, kuris šiuo metu tiria aukštos kokybės kino ir televizijos pramonę. „Warner Bros.“ paaiškino, kad šio apribojimo panaikinimas galėtų padidinti platintojų, įskaitant tuos, kurie platina nepriklausomus britų filmus, pasitikėjimą ir paskatas išleisti filmus kino teatruose. Taip yra todėl, kad jie galėtų derėtis dėl ilgesnių rodymo laikotarpių su atskirais kino teatrais. Jie toliau aiškino, kadangi dauguma filmų paprastai uždirba didžiąją dalį pajamų iš bilietų per pirmąjį išleidimo mėnesį, galimybė užsitikrinti papildomas dvi kino rodymo savaites galėtų labai paveikti, ar kai kurie filmai išvis pasirodys kino teatruose, ar padidėjusios išlaidos reklamai ir reklamai taps pagrįstos. Kitose savo pateikimo dalyse „Warner Bros.“ pabrėžė Gretos Gerwig filmo „Barbė“ ekonominį poveikį, pažymėdama jį kaip komerciškai sėkmingiausią kino teatrų išleidimą per visą laiką. Filmas tiesiogiai į JK vietos ekonomiką įliejo daugiau nei 80 milijonų svarų sterlingų ir sukūrė 685 darbo vietas JK gamybos metu „Warner Bros. Studios Leavesden“ studijoje netoli Londono. article_content: Pippa Middleton visited Kensington Palace this evening to meet her new nephew, following the arrival of the Duke and Duchess of Cambridge's first child. The Duchess of Cambridge's sister travelled to the west London palace with her boyfriend, Nico Jackson. Prince William and Kate were photographed arriving at Kensington Palace, having earlier departed the private Lindo Wing at St Mary's Hospital in London. Gathering: The Duke and Duchess of Cambridge returned to Kensington Palace this evening with their son. Pippa Middleton and her boyfriend Nico Jackson were there to meet the new arrival. Celebration: Crowds of people waved and cheered as the young family arrived home. They waved to cheering crowds and numerous journalists from around the world as they left the hospital, 26 hours after the heir to the throne was born, weighing 8lbs 6oz. The proud parents are expected to spend two weeks at Kensington Palace while William is on paternity leave. In addition to Pippa, other family members were also expected to be at the palace to celebrate the birth. Speaking outside the hospital earlier, the Duchess of Cambridge, visibly moved, said: 'It's been very emotional. Any parent will know what this feeling is like.' Family time: Pippa Middleton travelled to Kensington Palace to meet her new nephew this evening. The Duchess of Cambridge and Prince William presented their baby outside the hospital earlier. Proud: The Royal couple looked thrilled as they showed off their baby to the media outside the hospital. Home: The Duke and Duchess of Cambridge went to Kensington Palace in west London after leaving the hospital this evening. The Duke of Cambridge followed the example of his parents Charles and Diana 31 years prior, when he was born at the same hospital on June 21, 1982. 'He's a big boy, quite heavy. We're still deciding on a name,' he told reporters. 'He certainly has a good pair of lungs!' Confirming that the prince was overdue, William said: 'I will remind him of his tardiness when he is older.' Visit: Pippa Middleton travelled to Kensington Palace with her boyfriend Nico Jackson. They are pictured together watching tennis at Wimbledon. Beaming: Prince Harry and Pippa Middleton on the balcony of Buckingham Palace after the wedding of the Duke and Duchess of Cambridge. With a broad smile, he then added: 'He's got her looks, thankfully,' to which the Duchess responded: 'No, no, no, I'm not so sure about that.' The Duchess wore a lilac dress, with her long hair styled in waves around her face. The new father wore a blue open-neck shirt with rolled-up sleeves and black trousers. The couple then re-entered the hospital as William held his son, swaddled in a blanket, before bringing him out again in his car seat. William then visibly sighed with relief after successfully installing his baby in the back seat with his wife, before driving them home to Kensington Palace, surrounded by cheering crowds. Proud: Prince William drove his wife and son away from the Lindo Wing and to Kensington Palace. Happy: The new parents are now expected to spend two weeks at Kensington Palace. Carole and Michael Middleton were the first to arrive at the private Lindo Wing at approximately 3pm today, with Prince Charles and his wife Camilla following at 5.30pm, after being rushed to London by helicopter following two days of official duties in Yorkshire. Before ascending the St Mary's Hospital steps, the smiling Prince of Wales asked journalists, who had been waiting outside for almost three weeks: 'Have you been there long?'

article_content: Former Chelsea striker Demba Ba is set to make his debut for new club Besiktas in the unlikely surroundings of Macclesfield Town’s Moss Rose ground on Wednesday night. Ba, who completed his £8million signing in Istanbul last week, has returned immediately to England to join up with his team-mates on pre-season tour. The 29-year-old Senegal star is likely to play for Besiktas against German club Mainz as manager, former West Ham and Everton player Slaven Bilic, prepares for their Champions League third qualifying round tie against Feyenoord. Demba Ba will make his Besiktas debut at Macclesfield's ground on Wednesday night. Macclesfield’s pitch has a good reputation, which is why two European teams have chosen it as a venue. However, the Conference club’s stadium with its capacity of 6,355 will represent a change for Ba, who effectively decided the Premier League title race last season. His goal for Chelsea against Liverpool at Anfield, following a slip by Steve Gerrard, allowed eventual champions Manchester City to have the destiny of the title race back in their own hands. Ba will be the latest example of famous football players and managers having low-key debuts. Ba scored 87 goals in three years at West Ham, Newcastle United, and Chelsea. The first £1million footballer Trevor Francis was ordered by his Nottingham Forest manager Brian Clough to make his debut for the ‘A’ team against Notts County in the Midland Intermediate League. David Beckham’s Manchester United career started with a substitute appearance in a League Cup tie at Brighton, while David Moyes’ ill-fated reign as United manager last year began inauspiciously with a 1-0 defeat against the Singha All-Stars in Bangkok, Thailand. Ba scored 87 goals in three years at West Ham, Newcastle United and Chelsea but was deemed surplus to requirements by Chelsea manager Jose Mourinho following his purchase of £32million Atletico Madrid striker Diego Costa. Diego Costa (right) will be Jose Mourinho's main striker next season.

article_content: Spain manager Vicente del Bosque said that retired midfielder Xavi was even more important to the national team than him. Xavi ended his glittering international career on Tuesday having won one World Cup and two European Championships with Spain. Speaking to the official RFEF website, Del Bosque said Xavi was 'a key part of the team's style of play' and 'he was more important to us than even the manager.' End of an era: Barcelona midfielder Xavi announced his retirement from international football. Regular: Xavi played 133 times for Spain during a glittering 14-year international career. Happy days: Manager Vicente del Bosque and Xavi lift the World Cup in South Africa in 2010. The 34-year-old Barcelona midfielder played 133 times for his country during a 14-year international career and Del Bosque described him as 'one of the rocks we've had in our dressing room these past six years.' The Spain boss added: 'I would like to express my appreciation for a fantastic player. We have lost a unique footballer, and one who will be difficult to replace. We will miss him both on and off the pitch. He is a player who we hold in great esteem both personally and as a player. He is and always will be a person and a player who is greatly valued by the federation, the coaching staff and by myself.'
