article_content: In South Africa's MalaMala game reserve, wildlife photographer Gary Hill documented a dramatic encounter where a kudu antelope was hunted by lions. The incident unfolded as a pride of nineteen lions rested near the Sand River. Two lionesses moved away and then flushed out three kudu bulls from the nearby bush. In a panic, one kudu ran directly towards the resting pride, unknowingly heading into an ambush. A young lioness pursued the fleeing kudu. In a desperate attempt to escape, the kudu tried to buck and throw off the lioness. Despite this effort, the young lioness caught the kudu, and it was quickly surrounded by the rest of the pride. The lions swarmed the downed kudu, and the carcass was consumed rapidly by the large pride. Hill noted that a sub-adult lioness impressively executed the kill. Later, a herd of elephants approached. Initially appearing to ignore the lions, some elephants suddenly charged, scattering the pride, including cubs who struggled to retreat from the waterlogged area.

article_content: Dennis Wyness, 36, attacked a former teammate after seeing him helping his wife get a taxi home. Pictured with his wife Hazel on their wedding day. A professional footballer attacked a former teammate after he saw him helping his wife get a taxi home. Dennis Wyness, 36, and childhood friend Martin Bavidge had been out together before the assault. Mr Bavidge, 32, had gone to the Babylon nightclub with the Elgin City striker and his wife Hazel after they attended a fundraiser in Aberdeen on October 28 of the previous year. Wyness, from Westhill, Aberdeenshire, disappeared from the city centre club after his wife started dancing with other men. Mr Bavidge became concerned about her because she was unsteady on her feet and offered to help her get a taxi home in the early hours of the morning. However, he was punched to the ground when former Aberdeen star Wyness saw them together on the street a short distance from the nightclub. Wyness admitted assault when he appeared at Aberdeen Sheriff Court yesterday. Fiscal depute Lorna McLafferty stated: 'The victim was a semi-professional footballer with Peterhead Football Club.' 'The accused was known to him as a childhood friend and former teammate at Peterhead Football Club.' Miss McLafferty told the court that Mr Bavidge had been on his way to a taxi rank with Mrs Wyness when he was attacked by her husband. She said he had tried to contact Wyness on his mobile phone after leaving the Babylon nightclub but had been unable to reach him. He then asked for help from a friend, Robin Ritchie, with whom he had been out earlier that evening, to assist him in getting Mrs Wyness home. Mr Ritchie arrived and saw Wyness walking towards them on Union Street in the city. Miss McLafferty said: 'The accused continued to walk past all the witnesses and raised his middle finger at them.' 'Seeing this, Mr Bavidge approached the accused and asked him what was wrong.' 'Mr Bavidge and the accused were facing each other.' 'Mr Ritchie saw Mr Bavidge make a motion with his shoulder as if the accused had struck out, and Mr Bavidge was observed falling backwards onto the ground, hitting his head on the pavement.' The court heard that Wyness then 'casually' walked away, leaving his friend bleeding and unconscious on the ground. He was taken to hospital with head injuries and received five stitches to the back of his head. Doctors noted he had a blood clot on the inside of his cheek, believed to be from biting it as he fell. Former Elgin City player Dennis Wyness, 36, and childhood friend Martin Bavidge were out together before the attack in the early hours of October 28 of the previous year. Punched: Former teammate Martin Bavidge in action for Peterhead. When police officers went to the family home the next day, Mrs Wyness told them she had been intoxicated and had not seen anything. Her husband later went to the police and made a full confession. Miss McLafferty said: 'The accused admitted that he had punched Mr Bavidge once in the face because he was angry about Mr Bavidge being with Mrs Wyness.' 'He stated that he had not realised Mr Bavidge was seriously injured.' Sentencing was deferred until next month for background reports. Outside court, defence lawyer Charles Benzies said his client regretted what had happened. He added: 'Mr Wyness wants to apologise. He is 36 years old and has never been in trouble before.' 'He hopes Mr Bavidge makes a full recovery and has no ill feelings towards him now.' 'Mr Bavidge has returned to playing football, and it has not affected his career.' Wyness began his career with Aberdeen in 1996 but went on loan to Inverness Caledonian Thistle in 1999. He signed for Caley Thistle in 2000 and was the club's top scorer in 2000-01. Wyness went on to play for Hearts, St Mirren, Queen of the South, and Peterhead before moving to Elgin City last year.

article_content: Actor Daniel Radcliffe has reason to celebrate this Christmas, as it has been revealed he made a £6 million profit this year. The company managing his assets, including earnings related to the Harry Potter franchise, is now valued at £54,079,238. Accounts for the 24-year-old actor's firm, Gilmore Jacobs, demonstrate that the Harry Potter star maintains his position as Britain's top-earning young actor. Last year, Gilmore Jacobs, which also manages Radcliffe's properties in the United States, was valued at £47.9 million in 2012, an increase of nearly £17 million from the previous year. As the accounts are for a small business, they do not disclose the exact amount the actor paid himself in dividends. Gilmore Jacobs was established in 2000 by Radcliffe’s father, Alan, a literary agent, and his mother, Marcia, to manage his earnings from the successful films. Assets include two subsidiary property companies in New York and Los Angeles, collectively valued at nearly £8 million. These subsidiaries are believed to own Radcliffe’s property in the United States. Gilmore Jacobs has substantial cash reserves, with £9.3 million in the bank – an increase of more than £5 million from the previous year – which the actor can access readily. Radcliffe, born in Fulham, south west London, made his acting debut in the BBC1 drama David Copperfield in 1999. He was chosen from 40,000 young applicants to play the lead role in the JK Rowling book adaptations, first appearing as Harry Potter in Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone in 2001, at the age of 12. Since then, he has starred in seven more Harry Potter films, including the final installment, Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows Part Two, released in 2011. Radcliffe transitioned to the stage in 2007, notably appearing nude in productions of Equus in London and New York, before venturing into musical theatre in a 2011 Broadway revival of the musical How To Succeed in Business Without Really Trying. This year, he received praise for his portrayal of beat poet Allen Ginsberg in the independent film Kill Your Darlings. Last year, Radcliffe admitted in an interview that he felt embarrassed by the amount of money he has earned through acting. ‘I got paid very well for doing the Harry Potter films, it's excessive. If someone asked me, “Did you think you deserve that money?” No, of course I didn't,’ he told Parade magazine. ‘But would you have taken it anyway?’ Of course. I happened to find myself in this industry where people are paid exorbitant amounts of money. ‘That's the reality. I feel almost guilty for having benefited so much from Potter.’ Radcliffe also appeared in the 2013 television series A Young Doctor's Notebook with Jon Hamm.

Bendrovės, valdančios jo turtą, įskaitant pajamas, susijusias su Hario Poterio franšize, vertė dabar siekia 54 079 238 svarus sterlingų. 24 metų aktoriaus firmos „Gilmore Jacobs“ apskaitos dokumentai rodo, kad Hario Poterio žvaigždė išlaiko savo pozicijas kaip daugiausiai uždirbantis jaunas aktorius Britanijoje. Praėjusiais metais „Gilmore Jacobs“, kuri taip pat valdo Radcliffe'o turtą Jungtinėse Valstijose, 2012 m. buvo įvertinta 47,9 milijono svarų sterlingų, o tai yra beveik 17 milijonų svarų sterlingų daugiau nei ankstesniais metais. Kadangi sąskaitos yra skirtos smulkiam verslui, jose neatskleidžiama tiksli suma, kurią aktorius sau išmokėjo dividendų. „Gilmore Jacobs“ 2000 m. įkūrė Radcliffe'o tėvas Alanas, literatūros agentas, ir jo motina Marcia, kad valdytų jo pajamas iš sėkmingų filmų. Turtą sudaro dvi patronuojamosios nekilnojamojo turto bendrovės Niujorke ir Los Andžele, kurių bendra vertė siekia beveik 8 milijonus svarų sterlingų. Manoma, kad šios patronuojamosios bendrovės valdo Radcliffe'o turtą Jungtinėse Valstijose. „Gilmore Jacobs“ turi dideles grynųjų pinigų atsargas – 9,3 milijono svarų sterlingų banke – tai daugiau nei 5 milijonai svarų sterlingų daugiau nei praėjusiais metais – kuriuos aktorius gali lengvai pasiekti. Radcliffe'as, gimęs Fulhame, pietvakarių Londone, debiutavo aktorystėje 1999 m. BBC1 dramoje „David Copperfield“. Jis buvo išrinktas iš 40 000 jaunų kandidatų atlikti pagrindinį vaidmenį JK Rowling knygų ekranizacijose ir pirmą kartą pasirodė kaip Haris Poteris filme „Haris Poteris ir filosofijos akmuo“ 2001 m., būdamas 12 metų. Nuo tada jis vaidino dar septyniuose Hario Poterio filmuose, įskaitant paskutinę dalį „Haris Poteris ir Mirties relikvijos. 2 dalis“, išleistą 2011 m. Radcliffe'as 2007 m. perėjo į sceną, ypač pastebimai pasirodydamas nuogas spektakliuose „Equus“ Londone ir Niujorke, prieš pasiryždamas muzikiniam teatrui 2011 m. Brodvėjaus miuziklo „Kaip sėkmingai veikti versle sunkiai nesistengiant“ atgaivinime. Šiais metais jis buvo pagirtas už bitnikų poeto Alleno Ginsbergo vaidmenį nepriklausomame filme „Kill Your Darlings“ (Nužudyk savo numylėtinius). Praėjusiais metais Radcliffe'as interviu prisipažino, kad jaučiasi susigėdęs dėl pinigų sumos, kurią uždirbo vaidindamas. „Man labai gerai mokėjo už Hario Poterio filmus, tai per daug. Jei kas manęs paklaustų: „Ar tu manai, kad nusipelnei tų pinigų?“ Ne, žinoma, ne“, – sakė jis žurnalui „Parade“. „Bet ar būtumėte vis tiek juos paėmęs?“ Žinoma. Aš atsidūriau šioje industrijoje, kur žmonėms mokami didžiuliai pinigai. „Tokia realybė. Jaučiuosi beveik kaltas, kad tiek daug naudos gavau iš Poterio.“ Radcliffe'as taip pat pasirodė 2013 m. televizijos seriale „Jaunojo gydytojo užrašai“ su Jonu Hammu.

article_content: In Mexico, a 14-year-old boy has been diagnosed with gerascophobia, a rare condition characterized by an excessive fear of aging. (Note: Image is posed by a model.) Driven by an intense fear of growing older, this teenager resorted to extreme measures to hinder his physical development. He drastically reduced his food intake and intentionally distorted his voice. Additionally, the boy adopted a hunched posture to appear shorter and researched online methods to prevent ejaculation. A recently published report detailing his case indicates that the boy's phobia emerged around the age of 12. Believing that nutrients from food would accelerate his growth, he severely restricted his diet, resulting in a weight loss of over 26 pounds (12 kilograms). Specialists at the Universidad Autónoma de Nuevo León in northern Mexico identified his condition as gerascophobia. They observed that the teenager perceived his body's natural development as a threat, leading him to take drastic actions to halt or conceal his growth. The report highlights, "Any physical change indicative of growth triggers fear and anxiety in him, to the point where he contemplated undergoing multiple surgeries to hide these changes." "He becomes extremely distressed and weeps if people comment on him being taller or older," the report further states. Psychiatrists who assessed the teenager found a history of separation anxiety dating back to when he was five years old. They also uncovered that he had been sexually abused by a neighbor at age six and had been a frequent target of bullying. Researchers suggest that these three factors contributed to the boy's anxiety and depression, causing him to fixate on specific physical attributes. However, the teenager expressed that adult expectations, such as finding a partner, achieving independence, and managing greater responsibilities and finances, seemed "excessive" to him. The report further explains, "He also holds the belief that reaching adulthood increases his susceptibility to illness and death, all of which feels overwhelmingly daunting." Psychiatrists noted that after extensive research, they found only one other documented instance of similar fear of aging cases. Despite the gerascophobia diagnosis, other medical professionals, speaking to Livescience, suggested that the teenager's condition might be categorized as body dysmorphic disorder or gender dysmorphic disorder. Martin Antony, a psychology professor at Ryerson University in Toronto, commented, "Others might diagnose this as a different issue than what these authors have identified." Dr. Luis Gonzalez Mendoza, director of pediatric endocrinology at Miami Children's Hospital, concurred with this alternative perspective. The boy went to extremes to prevent growing up, including starvation, stooping, and voice distortion, according to the case analysis. (Pictured: Statue of Peter Pan, the boy who never grew up.) Dr. Mendoza attributed the boy's symptoms to gender dysphoria, where an individual does not identify with their biological sex and fears puberty due to discomfort with bodily changes. Doctors at the Universidad Autónoma de Nuevo León treated the boy with the antidepressant fluoxetine, along with psychotherapy and family therapy. This treatment proved effective. The boy began standing upright and speaking in his natural voice. His eating habits improved, and he gained 13 pounds (6 kilograms). The report concluded, "He is now able to envision his future, including living independently and pursuing an acting career, ideas he finds appealing. He continues to express apprehension about commitment and adult responsibilities." The case report was published in the journal Case Reports in Psychiatry.
translated_content: Meksikoje 14-metis berniukas buvo diagnozuotas su reta būkle – gerascofobija, pasireiškiančia pernelyg didele senėjimo baime. (Nuotrauka pozuota modelio.) Dėl didžiulės baimės užaugti, šis paauglys ėmėsi kraštutinių priemonių, kad sustabdytų savo fizinį vystymąsi. Jis drastiškai sumažino maisto suvartojimą ir sąmoningai iškraipė savo balsą. Be to, berniukas pradėjo laikytis susikūprinusios laikysenos, kad atrodytų žemesnis, ir internete ieškojo būdų, kaip išvengti ejakuliacijos. Neseniai paskelbtoje ataskaitoje, kurioje išsamiai aprašomas jo atvejis, nurodoma, kad berniuko fobija prasidėjo maždaug 12 metų amžiaus. Tikėdamas, kad maistinės medžiagos iš maisto paspartins jo augimą, jis smarkiai apribojo savo mitybą, dėl ko numetė daugiau nei 12 kilogramų svorio (daugiau nei 12 kg). Šiaurės Meksikoje esančio Universidad Autónoma de Nuevo León specialistai nustatė, kad jo būklė yra gerascofobija. Jie pastebėjo, kad paauglys suvokė savo kūno natūralų vystymąsi kaip grėsmę, todėl ėmėsi drastiškų veiksmų, kad sustabdytų arba paslėptų augimą. Ataskaitoje pabrėžiama: "Bet koks fizinis pokytis, rodantis augimą, jam sukelia baimę ir nerimą, iki tokio lygio, kad jis svarstė galimybę atlikti kelias operacijas, kad paslėptų šiuos pokyčius." "Jei žmonės jam sako, kad jis yra aukštesnis ar vyresnis, jis labai nusimena ir verkia", – toliau teigiama ataskaitoje. Psichiatrai, įvertinę paauglį, nustatė, kad jam buvo nerimo sutrikimas dėl atsiskyrimo, kuris prasidėjo, kai jam buvo penkeri metai. Jie taip pat išsiaiškino, kad šešerių metų amžiaus jį seksualiai išnaudojo kaimynas ir jis dažnai patyrė patyčias. Tyrėjai teigia, kad šie trys veiksniai prisidėjo prie berniuko nerimo ir depresijos, todėl jis sutelkė dėmesį į tam tikras fizines savybes. Tačiau paauglys išreiškė nuomonę, kad suaugusiųjų lūkesčiai, tokie kaip partnerio susiradimas, savarankiškumo pasiekimas ir didesnės atsakomybės bei finansų valdymas, jam atrodė "pernelyg dideli". Ataskaitoje toliau aiškinama: "Jis taip pat tiki, kad sulaukęs pilnametystės labiau susirgs ir mirs, o visa tai jam atrodo labai baugu." Psichiatrai pažymėjo, kad atlikę išsamius tyrimus rado tik vieną kitą dokumentuotą panašios senėjimo baimės atvejį. Nepaisant gerascofobijos diagnozės, kiti medicinos specialistai, kalbėdami su "Livescience", teigė, kad paauglio būklę galima būtų priskirti kūno dismorfiniam arba lyties dismorfiniam sutrikimui. Martinas Antony, psichologijos profesorius Ryerson universitete Toronte, pakomentavo: "Kiti galėtų diagnozuoti tai kaip kitokią problemą nei ta, kurią nustatė šie autoriai." Dr. Luisas Gonzalezas Mendoza, Majamio vaikų ligoninės vaikų endokrinologijos direktorius, pritarė šiai alternatyviai perspektyvai. Remiantis atvejo analize, berniukas ėmėsi kraštutinių priemonių, kad išvengtų užaugimo, įskaitant badavimą, kūprinimąsi ir balso iškraipymą. (Nuotraukoje – Petro Pano, berniuko, kuris niekada neužaugo, statula.) Dr. Mendoza berniuko simptomus priskyrė lyties disforijai, kai asmuo neidentifikuoja savęs su savo biologine lytimi ir bijo brendimo dėl diskomforto, kurį sukelia kūno pokyčiai. Universidad Autónoma de Nuevo León gydytojai gydė berniuką antidepresantu fluoksetinu, kartu taikydami psichoterapiją ir šeimos terapiją. Šis gydymas pasirodė veiksmingas. Berniukas pradėjo stovėti tiesiai ir kalbėti natūraliu balsu. Jo mitybos įpročiai pagerėjo, ir jis priaugo 6 kilogramus (13 svarų). Ataskaitoje padaryta išvada: "Dabar jis gali įsivaizduoti savo ateitį, įskaitant savarankišką gyvenimą ir aktoriaus karjerą – idėjas, kurios jam patinka. Jis ir toliau išreiškia nerimą dėl įsipareigojimų ir suaugusiųjų atsakomybės." Atvejo ataskaita buvo paskelbta žurnale "Case Reports in Psychiatry".

article_content: In a display of quintessential Australian spirit, a group of friends turned a flooded roadway into an impromptu wakeboarding venue following Tropical Cyclone Oswald. Just days after record-breaking heat, torrential rains from the cyclone inundated parts of Australia, creating unusual conditions. Opting to make the most of the situation, these adventurous individuals were spotted wakeboarding through the murky floodwaters. They used a pickup truck to pull themselves along the waterlogged road, which had been closed due to the flooding. Photographer Shay Bourne, drawn to the scene by the flooding, captured the group’s exploits in Brimsmead, near Cairns in Northern Queensland. He described the young men as ‘tough lads’ who were thoroughly enjoying themselves, despite a few spills into the dirty water, which was runoff from nearby sugar cane fields. One of the wakeboarders, 18-year-old carpenter Jake Wright, mentioned they were simply looking to ‘have a bit of fun’ during their free time.  The recent extreme weather, triggered by Tropical Cyclone Oswald, has caused widespread damage across eastern Australia, including severe flooding, strong winds, and heavy rain, leading to numerous evacuations and tragically, at least four deaths. Areas like the Sunshine and Gold Coasts have been heavily impacted, experiencing significant swells. In Bundaberg, Queensland, over a thousand people were rescued by helicopter as the Burnett River overflowed, inundating approximately 2,000 residences. Tens of thousands were displaced by the floods, which peaked earlier in the week. Tropical Cyclone Oswald has since moved out to sea, heading south of Sydney, and recovery efforts are underway with military assistance as water levels recede.
translated_content: Demonstruodami tipišką australietišką dvasią, grupė draugų po atogrąžų ciklono Osvaldo užtvindytą kelią pavertė improvizuota vandenlenčių sporto vieta. Vos kelios dienos po rekordinio karščio, smarkios ciklonų liūtys užliejo dalį Australijos, sukurdamos neįprastas sąlygas. Nusprendę išnaudoti situaciją, šie nuotykių ieškotojai buvo pastebėti vandenlenčių sportu užsiimantys drumstuose potvynio vandenyse. Jie naudojo pikapą, kad trauktųsi vandeniu užtvindytu keliu, kuris buvo uždarytas dėl potvynio. Fotografas Shay Bourne, pritrauktas potvynio scenos, užfiksavo grupės išdaigas Brimsmead mieste, netoli Kernso, Šiaurės Kvinslande. Jis apibūdino jaunuolius kaip „kietus vaikinus“, kurie nuoširdžiai linksminosi, nepaisant kelių kritimų į purviną vandenį, kuris buvo nuplaukęs nuo netoliese esančių cukranendrių laukų. Vienas iš vandenlentininkų, 18-metis dailidė Džeikas Raitas, paminėjo, kad jie tiesiog norėjo „šiek tiek pasilinksminti“ laisvalaikiu. Pastarasis ekstremalus oras, kurį sukėlė atogrąžų ciklonas Osvaldas, padarė didelę žalą Rytų Australijoje, įskaitant smarkius potvynius, stiprius vėjus ir smarkų lietų, dėl kurių buvo evakuota daugybė žmonių ir, deja, žuvo mažiausiai keturi žmonės. Tokios vietovės kaip Saulėtoji ir Auksinė pakrantės buvo smarkiai paveiktos, patiriant dideles bangas. Bundaberge, Kvinslande, sraigtasparniais buvo išgelbėta daugiau nei tūkstantis žmonių, kai perlijo Burneto upė, užliedama apie 2000 gyvenamųjų namų. Dešimtys tūkstančių žmonių buvo perkelti dėl potvynių, kurie pasiekė piką anksčiau savaitę. Atogrąžų ciklonas Osvaldas jau išplaukė į jūrą, judėdamas į pietus nuo Sidnėjaus, ir, vandens lygiui mažėjant, vykdomi atkūrimo darbai, padedant kariuomenei.

article_content: Administrators at Akron Children's Hospital have initiated legal proceedings to mandate chemotherapy for Sarah Hershberger, a 10-year-old leukemia patient. Sarah was brought to the Ohio hospital by her parents, Andy and Anna Hershberger, for treatment of tumors on her kidney, neck, and chest, some of which were visibly apparent. Initially, the Hershbergers consented to chemotherapy, and Sarah underwent some sessions. However, they subsequently decided to discontinue this treatment, opting instead for natural medicine, including vitamins and herbs. Having previously been denied guardianship of Sarah, Akron Children's Hospital is now appealing to a different judge. The Medina Gazette reported that an initial request for guardianship was rejected by a retired Ohio judge, John Lohn. Maria Schimer, the hospital's attorney and a registered nurse, is seeking legal guardianship to authorize medical decisions for Sarah. In his ruling, Judge Lohn stated that there was no evidence to suggest parental unfitness, describing Andy and Anna Hershberger as 'caring, attentive, protective and concerned'. Court records indicate Sarah received chemotherapy for a period sufficient to reduce visible tumors on her neck and chest, although she did not achieve remission. Judge Lohn noted Sarah's expressed desire to stop chemotherapy and her parents' distress at witnessing her suffering during treatment. Sarah reportedly complained of feeling unwell and expressed concerns about potential infertility, which are recognized side effects of chemotherapy, along with nausea and organ damage. Medical professionals at the hospital emphasize that the decision regarding Sarah's treatment is critical, with life-or-death implications. Anna Hershberger stated that she 'prayed for wisdom' and believes chemotherapy was detrimental to Sarah's health. The Hershberger family adheres to Amish traditions, which include limited use of technology and certain aspects of modern medicine. Maria Schimer contends that the parents' chosen course of action is likely to be fatal for Sarah. She argued that each day without chemotherapy reduces Sarah's chances of survival, whereas chemotherapy offers an 85% survival probability.
translated_content: Akrono vaikų ligoninės administracija pradėjo teismo procesą, siekdama įpareigoti chemoterapiją dešimtmetei pacientei Sarah Hershberger, sergančiai leukemija. Sarah į Ohajo ligoninę atvežė jos tėvai Andy ir Anna Hershberger, kad būtų gydomi augliai ant inkstų, kaklo ir krūtinės, kai kurie iš kurių buvo aiškiai matomi. Iš pradžių Hershbergeriai sutiko su Sarah chemoterapija, ir ji buvo gydoma kelis kartus. Tačiau vėliau jie nusprendė gydymą nutraukti, pirmenybę teikdami natūraliai medicinai, pavyzdžiui, vitaminams ir žolelėms. Akrono vaikų ligoninė, kurios prašymas dėl globos jau buvo atmestas, dabar kreipiasi į kitą teisėją. „Medina Gazette“ pranešė, kad pirminį prašymą dėl globos atmetė pensiją išėjęs Ohajo teisėjas Johnas Lohnas. Maria Schimer, ligoninės advokatė ir registruota slaugytoja, siekia teisinės globos, kad galėtų priimti medicininius sprendimus Sarah vardu. Savo sprendime teisėjas Lohnas pareiškė, kad nėra jokių įrodymų, rodančių tėvų netinkamumą, ir apibūdino Andy ir Anną Hershberger kaip „rūpestingus, dėmesingus, saugančius ir susirūpinusius“. Teismo dokumentai rodo, kad Sarah chemoterapija buvo taikoma pakankamai ilgai, kad sumažėtų matomi augliai ant kaklo ir krūtinės, nors remisija nebuvo pasiekta. Teisėjas Lohnas paminėjo Sarah prašymus nutraukti gydymą ir tėvų sielvartą matant jos kančias gydymo metu. Pranešama, kad Sarah skundėsi silpnumu ir nerimavo dėl galimo nevaisingumo, kuris yra žinomas chemoterapijos šalutinis poveikis, kartu su pykinimu ir organų pažeidimais. Ligoninės gydytojai pabrėžia, kad Sarah gydymo klausimas yra gyvybės ir mirties klausimas. Ponia Hershberger pareiškė, kad „meldė išminties“ ir tiki, kad terapija kenkia Sarah. Hershbergerių šeima yra amišai, o jų tradicijos verčia vengti technologijų ir, savo ruožtu, kai kurių šiuolaikinės medicinos formų. Ligoninės advokatė Maria Schimer dabar apskundžia sprendimą ir tikisi gauti ribotą globą, kad ji būtų atsakinga už medicininių sprendimų priėmimą Sarah vardu. Maria Schimer teigia, kad tėvų pateiktas planas beveik neabejotinai lems Sarah mirtį. „Kiekviena diena be gydymo mažina Sarah galimybę išgyventi vėžį“, – rašė ji laiške teismui. Taikant chemoterapiją, jos išgyvenimo galimybės padidėja iki 85 procentų.
